app.name: Regime Radar
app.tagline: Which cyber-incident reporting regimes apply to your company?

landing.title: Which reporting duties apply to your company?
landing.intro: Germany, Austria and Switzerland have introduced new cyber-incident reporting regimes (NIS2UmsuCG, NISG 2024, ISG). We automatically assess which regimes apply to you, which thresholds are relevant, and where your public-facing security gaps are – in under three minutes, no login required.
landing.disclaimer_short: Automated public-footprint assessment – not legal advice.

intake.title: Eight questions – then we scan
intake.subtitle: Your answers are the basis of the legal assessment and are used only for your report.
intake.q6_hint: Pick the sector that applies. Special categories (e.g. official critical-infrastructure designation) are at the end of the list.
intake.q7_hint: Multiple selection allowed – an empty selection means “no known subsidiaries”.
intake.q8_label: Do you have EU customers that impose contractual security requirements on you?
intake.q8_hint: Relevant for possible indirect duties (e.g. Switzerland).
intake.supply_chain_label: We are part of a supply chain whose failure would affect critical infrastructure or public clients
intake.critical_label: We are officially designated as critical infrastructure / a critical facility
intake.trust_service_label: We are a qualified trust service provider (eIDAS)
intake.email_hint: The report link will be sent to this address. You can access the report without login via your personal link.
intake.consent_label: I agree that Regime Radar may occasionally inform me about updates to reporting duties (cancellable anytime).

limits.mode_fixture: Demo mode (fixture data, no live requests)
limits.mode_live: Live scan of the public footprint
limits.body: This report was generated automatically: an automated evaluation of publicly available sources (DNS, TLS, HTTP headers, published web pages) combined with your answers. It is a first orientation and **not legal advice**. A full compliance assessment requires internal system information that we cannot see. Legal standing and confidence are shown per regime; uncertain legal situations are honestly reported as “unclear”.

report.disclaimer_footer: Automated public assessment · not legal advice · legal standing shown in report
